svg.aria-label: Why the one-sentence game prompt lands: densest training corpus, a task with natural edges, and verification that collapses into playing

g.text: three boring properties, stacked — the third is the one worth stealing
tutorial games are among the most-rewritten code on the internet: the corpus has rehearsed the answer
one file, no dependencies, no integration surface — worst case is a tab you close
the acceptance check is playing for two minutes: fast, pleasant, and blind to the implementation
"you become the verification loop" — here, that job is called playing
concept diagram — illustrative; quote per Anthropic best-practices doc (as of 2026-08)
